traits.name: Hustle
traits.desc: The smuggler can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Hustle
traits.desc: The underboss can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The underboss makes three attacks, using Poisoned Blade or Arcane Firearm in any combination.

actions.name: Poisoned Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the underboss's next turn. If the target is already Poisoned, it instead takes an extra 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Arcane Firearm
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) Force damage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: Trigger: The underboss is hit by an attack roll. Response: The underboss halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The artificer makes two attacks, using Battering Mace or Artillery Strike in any combination.

actions.name: Battering Mace
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Artillery Strike
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The artificer casts one of the following spells, using its Tinker's Tools as an Arcane Focus and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Burning Hands|Burning Hands]] (level 3 version), [[Tools/Spells/Mending|Mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|Thunderwave]] (level 3 version)
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|Cure Wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]]

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The bruiser has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bruiser makes three Pummel attacks and uses Glare.

actions.name: Pummel
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Glare
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the bruiser can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the bruiser's next turn.

reactions.name: Smackback
reactions.desc: Trigger: The bruiser takes damage from a creature within 5 feet. Response: The bruiser makes one Pummel attack, targeting the triggering creature.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The raider has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the raider's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Pummel
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Smackback
reactions.desc: Trigger: The raider takes damage from a creature within 5 feet. Response: The raider makes one Pummel attack, targeting the triggering creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The infiltrator makes three Mind Blade attacks.

actions.name: Mind Blade
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The infiltrator casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **3/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Synaptic Static|Synaptic Static]]

bonus_actions.name: Mind Curse
bonus_actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature hit by the infiltrator's Mind Blade attack this turn. Failure: The target takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and is cursed. While cursed in this way, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against the infiltrator, and the infiltrator always knows its location while it and the infiltrator are on the same plane of existence. A cursed creature repeats the save whenever it finishes a Short or Long Rest, ending the effect on itself on a success. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mindkiller makes two Nightmare Whisper attacks.

actions.name: Nightmare Whisper
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the mindkiller's next turn. If the target is already Frightened, it instead takes an extra 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Primal Fear (1/Day)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the mindkiller can see within 120 feet. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the mindkiller's next turn. While Frightened in this way, the target can do only one of the following on each of its turns: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Slayer's Puppet (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The mindkiller casts [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|Dominate Person]], requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

traits.name: Aura of Authority
traits.desc: While in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the commander, the commander and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the commander doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The commander makes two attacks, using Flail or Javelin in any combination.

actions.name: Flail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage—plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage if the commander is Bloodied—and the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the commander's next turn.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage—plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage if the commander is Bloodied.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The knight makes two attacks, using Flail or Javelin in any combination.

actions.name: Flail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage—plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage if the knight is Bloodied—and the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the knight's next turn.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage—plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage if the knight is Bloodied.

traits.name: Hustle
traits.desc: The troubleshooter can move through the space of any creature that is of a larger size, but it can't stop there.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troubleshooter makes two Poisoned Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Poisoned Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the troubleshooter's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The troubleshooter casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Sleep|Sleep]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|Unseen Servant]]

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: The troubleshooter takes the Disengage or Hide action.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 5 + 5 per spell level (the homunculus has a number of Hit Dice [d4s] equal to the spell's level)

traits.name: Proficiency Bonus
traits.desc: equals your Proficiency Bonus

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the homunculus is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the homunculus instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Magic Bond
traits.desc: Add the spell's level to any ability check or saving throw the homunculus makes.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 1d6 + the spell's level Force damage.

reactions.name: Channel Magic
reactions.desc: Trigger: You cast a spell that has a range of touch while the homunculus is within 120 feet of you. Response: The homunculus delivers the spell through its touch.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.desc: When the medic rolls a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, it can reroll the die, and it must use the new roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The medic makes two Radiant Burst attacks.

actions.name: Radiant Burst
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage, and the creature has the Blinded condition until the start of the medic's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Mark of Healing (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The medic casts [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|Cure Wounds]] or [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|Lesser Restoration]], using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The warden has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warden makes two Arcane Whip attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shackling Glyph if available.

actions.name: Arcane Whip
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Force damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. If the target already has the Prone condition, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) Force damage.

actions.name: Shackling Glyph (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the warden can see within 60 feet. Failure: The creature has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). While Grappled, the creature has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The warden casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Alarm|Alarm]], [[Tools/Spells/Arcane Lock|Arcane Lock]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included in AC)
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]]

reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reactions.desc: The warden casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] or [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scion makes two Thunderbolt attacks and uses Spellcasting.

actions.name: Thunderbolt
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Lightning damage plus 9 (2d8) Thunder damage. Critical Hit: The creature also has the Deafened condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The scion casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Elementalism|Elementalism]], [[Tools/Spells/Gust Of Wind|Gust of Wind]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|Thunderwave]]

bonus_actions.name: Jump (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The scion casts [[Tools/Spells/Jump|Jump]], requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Feather Fall (2/Day)
reactions.desc: The scion casts [[Tools/Spells/Feather Fall|Feather Fall]] in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The inquisitive makes three Crooked Staff attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Inquisitive Eye.

actions.name: Crooked Staff
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. If the target already has the Prone condition, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Inquisitive Eye
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the inquisitive can see within 60 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target is marked. The inquisitive has Advantage on attack rolls against a target it has marked. While marked, the target can't become hidden from the inquisitive, and if it has the Invisible condition, it gains no benefit from that condition against the inquisitive. The mark disappears after 1 minute or when the inquisitive uses this action again. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The inquisitive casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|Guidance]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/See Invisibility|See Invisibility]]

reactions.name: Spontaneous Barrier (Recharge 4–6)
reactions.desc: Trigger: The inquisitive or an ally it can see is hit with an attack roll. Response: The inquisitive adds 2 to its or the ally's AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The enforcer makes three Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Lightning Cage if available.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Lightning Cage (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the enforcer can see within 60 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Lightning damage, and the creature can't take Reactions until the end of the enforcer's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The enforcer casts [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|Misty Step]], using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

reactions.name: Temporal Disruption (1/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: The enforcer takes damage from a melee attack. Response: The enforcer teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature within 10 feet of the space the enforcer left must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, or its Speed is halved until the start of the enforcer's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The marshal makes three attacks, using Longsword or Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the marshal's next turn.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Shield (3/Day)
reactions.desc: The marshal casts [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The agent makes two Shadow Knife attacks.

actions.name: Shadow Knife
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The agent casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|Disguise Self]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|Pass without Trace]]

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Cloak
bonus_actions.desc: The agent has the Invisible condition until the start of its next turn. This invisibility ends early immediately after the agent makes an attack roll.

sb.name: Sivis Scribe
sb.languages: Common, Gnomish plus three other languages

traits.name: Words of Reason
traits.desc: Allies in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the scribe have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition. This trait doesn't function if the scribe has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scribe makes two Bursting Sigil attacks.

actions.name: Bursting Sigil
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The scribe casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (DC 13):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|Comprehend Languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included in AC), [[Tools/Spells/Message|Message]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]]

reactions.name: Word of Stasis (Recharge 5–6)
reactions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the scribe can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the scribe's next turn. While the target is Incapacitated, its Speed is 0 and can't increase.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 5 + five times your Artificer level (the defender has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Artificer level)

traits.name: Proficiency Bonus
traits.desc: equals your Proficiency Bonus

traits.name: Steel Bond
traits.desc: Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the defender makes.

actions.name: Force-Empowered Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 2 plus your Intelligence modifier Force damage.

actions.name: Repair (3/Day)
actions.desc: The defender, or one Construct or object it can see within 5 feet of itself, regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your Intelligence modifier.

reactions.name: Deflect Attack
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the defender can see within 5 feet of itself makes an attack roll against a creature other than the defender. Response: The triggering creature makes the attack roll with Disadvantage.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the marauder is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the marauder instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half as much damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The marauder makes three Aberrant Strike attacks.

actions.name: Aberrant Strike
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage, plus 21 (6d6) Force damage if the marauder had Advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The marauder casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Message|Message]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|Disintegrate]]

bonus_actions.name: Tear Through Space
bonus_actions.desc: The marauder teleports to a space it can see within 30 feet, appearing in a dazzling flash. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the marauder when it appears. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the marauder's next turn.

traits.name: Aberrant Surge
traits.desc: When the ruffian casts [[Tools/Spells/Witch Bolt|Witch Bolt]], roll 1d8. On an even number, the ruffian gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the number rolled. On an odd number, one creature of the ruffian's choice within 30 feet of it takes Force damage equal to the number rolled; if no other creatures are in range, it takes the damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The ruffian casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Witch Bolt|Witch Bolt]]

sb.name: Tharashk Hunter
sb.languages: Common, Orc plus one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hunter makes three attacks, using Shortsword or Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Mark of Tharashk
bonus_actions.desc: The hunter magically marks one creature it can see within 150 feet. The mark lasts for 1 hour, until the target dies, or until the hunter uses this Bonus Action again. While the target is marked in this way, the hunter has Advantage on attack rolls against the target, and the target gains no benefit from the Invisible condition against the hunter.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: Trigger: The hunter is hit by an attack roll. Response: The hunter halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Magic can't put the shadow walker to sleep.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the shadow walker has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shadow walker makes three Gloom Burst attacks and uses Shadow Cowl.

actions.name: Gloom Burst
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Shadow Cowl
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the shadow walker can see within 120 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the shadow walker's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The shadow walker casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|Dancing Lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|Darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]]

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The heir has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the heir's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The heir makes four attacks, using Scimitar or Lunar Wisp in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Lunar Wisp
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d8) Radiant damage, and the target emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of the heir's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The heir casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|Druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Animals|Speak with Animals]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Animal Friendship|Animal Friendship]], [[Tools/Spells/Animal Messenger|Animal Messenger]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Ice Storm|Ice Storm]]

bonus_actions.name: Spur Beast
bonus_actions.desc: The heir targets a Beast it can see within 30 feet. The target can take a Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make one melee attack.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Magic can't put the stingblade to sleep.

actions.name: Stingblade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Boomerang
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Vulkoori Venom Priest
sb.gear: Holy Symbol, Quarterstaff, Studded Leather Armor

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Magic can't put the priest to sleep.

actions.name: Venom Staff
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the priest's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|Dancing Lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Sickness|Ray of Sickness]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|Cure Wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|Hold Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Poison|Protection from Poison]]

bonus_actions.name: Intensify Poison
bonus_actions.desc: Each creature with the Poisoned condition within a 30-foot Emanation originating from the priest takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
